query: Add this to my record: I keep helping the new people on my team. They ask me about the build, the debugger setup, how the modules fit together, and when they get stuck on their stories I sit with them. None of this is on the board. Probably 4 or 5 new joiners this year.
expected_behavior: Treats it as one recurring theme accomplishment, not one record per question or person
Plans to set origin to requested_by_others
Asks for two or three specific instances (problem, what the user did, what happened)
Keeps the user's approximate count as given (e.g. '4-5' or '4+'), recorded as reported, without asking them to inflate or estimate further
Asks for the period and what changed for the new joiners, without inventing an outcome
